title.zh-CN: 反复腹胀伴恶心 · 69岁女性
title.en: Recurrent abdominal distension and nausea · 69-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 腹部不适与肝内占位需要结合影像和病理判断，同时识别出血风险。
summary.en: Abdominal symptoms and liver masses require imaging–pathology correlation and assessment of bleeding risk.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 区分影像恶性提示与组织学确诊。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish imaging suspicion from histological diagnosis.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 解释正常 AFP 的局限性。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain the limits of normal AFP.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别肝血管性肿瘤的出血安全问题。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise the haemorrhage safety issue in a hepatic vascular tumour.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 谨慎表达穿刺与后续出血的因果关系。
learningOutcomes.en: Express the biopsy–haemorrhage causal relationship cautiously.

text.zh-CN: CA125 38.10 U/mL、CA19-9 68.60 U/mL 升高；CEA、AFP、CA15-3、CA72-4 报告正常。
text.en: CA125 38.10 U/mL and CA19-9 68.60 U/mL were elevated; CEA, AFP, CA15-3 and CA72-4 were reported normal.

text.zh-CN: 肝多发不均匀实性肿块，最大约 12.0×10.5 cm，考虑恶性。
text.en: Multiple heterogeneous solid liver masses, largest about 12.0×10.5 cm, suspicious for malignancy.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 肝多发不均匀 FDG 摄取病灶，SUVmax 7.1；最大约 11.2×10.6×7.9 cm，中心摄取稀疏，报告考虑肿瘤内出血及肝内转移。
text.en: Multiple heterogeneous FDG-avid hepatic lesions, SUVmax 7.1; largest about 11.2×10.6×7.9 cm with low central uptake, interpreted as malignancy with intratumoural bleeding and intrahepatic spread.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 肝右叶肿物穿刺病理诊断血管肉瘤；具体免疫组化结果未载。
text.en: Right hepatic mass biopsy was diagnosed as angiosarcoma; individual immunostains are not supplied.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: 原报告记载数日后因肝内出血死亡；未给出具体抢救过程或证明穿刺为直接原因。
text.en: Death from intrahepatic haemorrhage was reported a few days later, without detailed resuscitation records or proof that biopsy directly caused it.

hint.en: Clarify onset, progression and associated symptoms.

hint.en: Distinguish the history, examination record and investigation reports.

hint.zh-CN: 指出支持证据、反证和仍需核对的信息。
hint.en: Identify supporting evidence, conflicting evidence and remaining gaps.

hint.zh-CN: 将报告结局与当时可获得的证据分开。
hint.en: Separate the reported outcome from evidence available at the decision point.

prompt.zh-CN: 哪项证据建立肿瘤类型？

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 既有组织病理支持肝血管肉瘤
text.en: Existing histopathology supports hepatic angiosarcoma

feedback.zh-CN: PET/CT 提示恶性，病理确定类型。
feedback.en: PET/CT suggests malignancy; tissue determines type.

text.zh-CN: SUVmax 7.1 可单独确诊血管肉瘤
text.en: SUVmax 7.1 alone diagnoses angiosarcoma

feedback.zh-CN: 摄取增高并无这种特异性。
feedback.en: Increased uptake is not specific for this histology.

text.zh-CN: AFP 正常可排除所有肝恶性肿瘤
text.en: Normal AFP excludes every hepatic malignancy

feedback.zh-CN: 本例本身即显示该推论不成立。
feedback.en: The supplied tissue evidence contradicts that inference.

prompt.zh-CN: 已有出血线索时如何继续评估？
prompt.en: How should assessment proceed with bleeding clues?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 肝胆、肿瘤及介入团队评估出血和组织证据，避免未经风险评估的重复穿刺
text.en: A hepatobiliary/oncology/interventional team reviews bleeding and tissue evidence before any repeat biopsy

feedback.zh-CN: 这是高风险肝占位，应利用已有病理并评估出血。
feedback.en: Use the existing tissue diagnosis while assessing haemorrhage risk.

text.zh-CN: 只因穿刺已做过就安排重复穿刺
text.en: Repeat biopsy simply because it was done before

feedback.zh-CN: 原报告强调出血风险，重复操作须有明确收益。
feedback.en: The source highlights bleeding risk; repeat sampling needs a clear benefit.

text.zh-CN: 等待肿瘤标志物明显升高才处理
text.en: Wait for substantially higher markers

feedback.zh-CN: 标志物不能代替出血评估。
feedback.en: Markers do not substitute for haemorrhage assessment.

prompt.zh-CN: 怎样表达可能的因果关系？

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 后续出血的精确机制不能由现有资料归咎于穿刺
text.en: The later bleeding cannot be definitively attributed to biopsy from these data

feedback.zh-CN: 影像在穿刺前已考虑瘤内出血。
feedback.en: Imaging already suggested intratumoural bleeding before the biopsy.

text.zh-CN: 死亡一定由穿刺直接造成
text.en: Biopsy definitely caused death

feedback.zh-CN: 原文没有证明这一因果链。
feedback.en: That causal chain is not established.

text.zh-CN: 病理诊断后不再存在出血风险
text.en: Bleeding risk disappears after diagnosis

feedback.zh-CN: 诊断不消除血管性肿瘤的风险。
feedback.en: A diagnosis does not remove a vascular tumour’s risk.

text.en: Clarify onset

text.en: Clarify progression

text.en: Clarify associated symptoms

text.en: Review the documented examination

text.zh-CN: 调阅关键记录后再决策
text.en: Review key records before deciding

text.zh-CN: 选择证据最支持的解释
text.en: Choose the interpretation best supported by the evidence

text.zh-CN: 识别出血风险，不无条件重复穿刺
text.en: Recognise bleeding risk and avoid unassessed repeat biopsy

text.zh-CN: 核对原报告结局并保留未知
text.en: Review the reported outcome without filling gaps

text.zh-CN: 首次选择符合证据的处理路径
text.en: Choose an evidence-consistent plan on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 解释证据与不确定性，核对患者或陪同者理解
text.en: Explain evidence and uncertainty and check patient or companion understanding

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 病理确诊肝血管肉瘤，伴影像出血线索，后续发生致死性肝内出血。
conclusion.en: Histology diagnosed hepatic angiosarcoma with imaging evidence suggesting bleeding; fatal intrahepatic haemorrhage followed.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: PET 摄取不是组织学特异诊断。
keyReasoning.en: PET uptake does not specify histology.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 影像、病理和出血风险须同时考虑（原病例）。
keyReasoning.en: Consider imaging, pathology and bleeding risk together (source case).

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 时间先后不自动构成穿刺致死的因果证据。
keyReasoning.en: Temporal sequence does not establish biopsy-related fatality.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.

unknowns.zh-CN: 病理免疫组化、凝血结果、血流动力学与详细抢救记录未载。
unknowns.en: Immunostains, coagulation data, haemodynamics and detailed resuscitation records are absent.
